extension.summary: يعرض معلومات مخصصة عن عملية المشغل
显示自定义播放器进程信息
extension.description: يفتح نافذة مستقلة لمعلومات العملية. تعرض هذه النافذة تفاصيل برنامج الترميز (Codec) والفيديو والصوت الخاصة بالوسائط التي يتم تشغيلها حاليًا.
Öffnet ein eigenes Prozessinformationen-Fenster. Dieses enthält Codec-, Video- und Audio-Details zum aktuell abgespielten Medium.
Opens a separate process information window. This window displays codec, video, and audio details for the currently playing media.
Megnyit egy külön folyamatinformációs ablakot. Ez az ablak az aktuálisan lejátszott média kodek-, videó- és hangadatait jeleníti meg.
打开一个独立的进程信息窗口。此窗口显示当前播放媒体的编解码器、视频和音频详细信息。
extension.news: v2.14.1 - Web dashboard: much lighter on the box during library scans; the film and series lists stay current and are read only once for all open pages. - Web dashboard: the now-playing artwork comes from Kodi's texture cache. - Web dashboard: a device trying ten different wrong tokens is locked out for ten minutes; opened under a name outside the home network, the page always asks for the token. - Web dashboard: the page can no longer be framed by other sites and runs only its own files; open connections are capped, and the page also works in browsers that block local storage. - VS10 dialog: rapid taps no longer queue up; the last choice wins. - Hungarian translation completed. - General stability improvements.
